/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from urllib.request import urlopen, Request
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from uuid import uuid4
class ActionField(HTMLParser):
    name=None
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag=='input':
            val=dict(attrs).get('name','')
            if val.startswith('"'$ACTION_ID_'"'): self.name=val
url='http://localhost:3123/'
parser=ActionField(); parser.feed(urlopen(url).read().decode())
boundary='----TestBoundary'+uuid4().hex
fields={parser.name:'','title':'Fresh post multipart','content':'Visible immediately'}
body=b''.join((f'--{boundary}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{name}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n{value}\\r\\n').encode() for name,value in fields.items())+f'--{boundary}--\\r\\n'.encode()
res=urlopen(Request(url,data=body,headers={'Content-Type':f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}'}))
posted=res.read().decode()
print('POST status:',res.status,'cache:',res.headers.get('x-nextjs-cache'))
print('POST includes new post:', 'Fresh post multipart' in posted)
loaded=urlopen(url).read().decode()
print('Next GET includes new post:', 'Fresh post multipart' in loaded)
assert 'Fresh post multipart' in loaded
PY"
